description: sflow_2d_si_basin_bar with one refinement level in a static box over the bar (G 10): the composite eta system over the leaf cells of both levels (reefamr_si), coarse faces next to the patch replaced by the fine fluxes, global time step. The volume is conserved to round-off.
covers: reefamr_si: composite eta rows, CF flux replacement, RAS+FAC preconditioner
sflow_amr_si: stages on all levels, face matching of qE/q, restriction
